candidates.excerpt: The violence in Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Bordeaux and other cities occurred on the sidelines of mass demonstrations against high inflation caused in part from the U.S.-Iran war

candidates.title: Why the debate between Keynesian and orthodox economics matters
candidates.excerpt: Keynes-Kalecki framework holds that demand, in particular private investment, shapes short-term fluctuations as well as long-term growth, unlike orthodox approaches that see supply as determining long-term growth; shift towards inflation targeting coincided with falling wage shares and greater burden on workers
